order: # One row per banner photo on the home page, shown in 'order'. file = a photo in src/assets/img/hero/ (at least 2560 px wide; the site makes the smaller sizes). alt_en / alt_es = what the photo shows, for blind visitors. credit, source_url, license, license_url = the photo credit shown in the corner (the photo's license requires it).

# Phones show a tall crop of the photo, cut around position_mobile. To show a different, upright (portrait) photo on phones, put its file name in file_mobile. position_desktop / position_mobile = the point of the photo that stays in view, as 'left% top%' (e.g. 50% 30%).

# start / end (YYYY-MM-DD, optional) = show the photo only between these dates (seasonal photos). The first live row is the photo everyone sees first; the others fade in one after another (not for visitors who turn off animations).
